title: Finite pushforward preserves punctual upper bounds and purity
statement:
Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a finite morphism of separated finite-type schemes over a finite field, and let $\mathcal G$ be a constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf on $X_0$. If every local Frobenius eigenvalue of $\mathcal G$ at every closed point has weight at most $w$, then the same holds for $f_{0*}\mathcal G$. If $\mathcal G$ is punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $w$, then $f_{0*}\mathcal G$ is punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $w$.
Here finite morphism, constructibility, Weil sheaves, and direct image use [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-constructible-heart], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and [def-weil-derived-direct-image], with weights as in [def-weil-punctual-weights].
